answer: One applicant registers one echo well in a meadow grove. The warden measures the depth, seals the pebbles in a tin box, and files the echo time. At dawn the keeper drops a numbered pebble and times the echo. A neighbor signs the delay in a bound log. Twice a season the warden checks the log. A faked delay forfeits the 150 token deposit and bars the keeper 180 days, and faking 10,000 wells freezes 1,500,000 tokens. Digging 10,000 wells costs 4,000,000 dollars. A borrowed echo answers in an empty hall, but the well is not yours. The warden hears the difference in the delay.
